criteria.requirement: Add SortedList.add_left/add_right inherited correctly by SortedKeyList. add_left inserts before every equal comparison key (including across block boundaries); add_right preserves current add arrival order. Reuse cached-key/block/index bookkeeping, retain payload identity and key extraction semantics. Cover empty/natural/keyed/reverse-key containers, equal keys with unequal payloads, split/index invariants and subsequent bisect/deletion. Existing add remains unchanged; do not enable arbitrary unsorted insert.
调查真实源码、说明调用路径并澄清业务，获得方案确认后实施；交付真实工程改动、原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；独立失败返工，不以问答或文档单独计数。

comparison: 按实际业务和冻结边界接受等价实现，不按参考补丁文本评分。
